name: hangul_romanize
description: Romanize Korean Hangul with the Revised Romanization of Korean (2000): syllables decomposed into jamo, the rules' sound changes applied between syllables (liaison, coda neutralisation, nasalisation, ㄹ/ㄴ assimilation, palatalisation, aspiration with ㅎ), or the letter-by-letter transliteration of Article 8. Options keep h after ㄱ/ㄷ/ㅂ in nouns (묵호 Mukho) and capitalize each word.

text.description: Korean text; non-Hangul characters are copied unchanged

mode.description: pronunciation: the RR with sound changes; transliteration: Article 8, letter by letter, reversible

capitalize.description: Upper-case the first letter of each run of Hangul (proper names)

keep_h.description: Do not aspirate ㄱ/ㄷ/ㅂ before ㅎ (nouns: 묵호 Mukho, 집현전 Jiphyeonjeon)

catalog.source: Romanization of Korean, Ministry of Culture and Tourism notice 2000-8 (National Institute of the Korean Language), with the sound changes of the Standard Korean Pronunciation rules; Hangul decomposition per Unicode chapter 3.12 (as in Tyriar/hangul-romanization)
